title: Studies, surveys, rules.
bodyText: The department shall establish and make such studies, surveys, evaluations, and rules as are necessary to carry out the purposes of sections 302A-436 to 302A-443.
bodyHtml: [§302A-441]  Studies, surveys, rules.  The department shall establish and make such studies, surveys, evaluations, and rules as are necessary to carry out the purposes of sections 302A-436 to 302A-443. [L 1996, c 89, pt of §2]
